text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
How is it, Trainer? Don't you think I'm 
shining even brighter today!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I had a tea party with King 
yesterday! My princess power has 
skyrocketed~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
King-san would never eat a scone in one 
bite! She was so graceful~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having spent her day off with her idol, 
Kawakami Princess was brimming with 
motivation!
